'''Solrak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Korek]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] he was with his master on [[Voss]], where Korek sent Solrak to bring back artifacts from the [[Nightmare Lands]]. The corruption of the place, however, was too strong and Solrak asked an Imperial to retrieve the artifacts for him instead.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Apprentice Solrak appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Voss, where he begins the mission "Covetous".
